Tenant screening (BoomScreen) and leasing CRM endpoints of the Boom Partner API, version 2.

**What differs from v1.** Every `/partner/v1/` endpoint is also served under `/partner/v2/` with the same method, parameters, authentication, rate limits and API key scope. Responses are identical to v1 except: `owner` on a property (list, detail, create, update, and the property nested in units, users and property groups) is an object `{name, email, phone}`, or `null` when the property has no owner. In v1 it is the owner's name as a string. Request bodies are unchanged (`owner_name` is still accepted). Webhook payloads are not versioned and keep the v1 shape. See the v2 migration guide on docs.boompay.app.

**Authentication.** `POST /partner/v2/authenticate` with your API key pair returns a JWT; send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Keys are created self-serve under Settings → API. Read-only keys may only call GET endpoints (writes return 403 `forbidden`). Keys scoped to owners or property groups only see matching records.

**Conventions.** Every response carries an `X-Request-Id` header. Errors use one envelope: `{"error": {"message", "status", "code", "request_id"}}`. Lists use one envelope with `page` / `per_page` (max 1000) and a deterministic order. 429 responses carry `Retry-After`. See the Errors, Pagination, Rate limits and Versioning guides on docs.boompay.app.

Public listing endpoints under `/crm/v1/` are not part of Partner API versioning and are listed here unchanged. Rent reporting (BoomReport) endpoints are documented in the companion BoomReport API specification.

value.description: Owner of the property, or `null` when the property has no owner. Properties that only have a legacy owner name return it in `name` with `email` and `phone` set to `null`.
